active_continuity: Jin Taekyung possesses the Myriad-Poison Ring, but Item Appraisal says a special condition is required to appraise it.
The Divine Physician and Mungyeong have begun a fifteen-day treatment of Jeok Cheongang using the ring and Cold-Ice Stone in the deepest underground prison cell of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison.
Jin Taekyung recognizes Jeok Cheongang as his Master and has vowed to prevent anyone from approaching during the treatment.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
Cheongpung, Jin Taekyung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong are at the Sichuan Tang Clan for Jeok Cheongang's treatment.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord is a one-armed middle-aged martial artist who tortured and killed Tang Clan personnel after overcoming Poison King Tang Taesang's resistance.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord has summoned hundreds of black-robed hunters through a concealed Mystic Gate Formation.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord intends to hunt Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan.
open_questions: Will the Divine Physician's fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang?
What special condition is required to appraise the Myriad-Poison Ring?
Can Emei, Qingcheng, and the Sichuan Tang Clan withstand the Western Heaven Demon Lord's planned hunt?
What is the identity and purpose of the Lord of Heaven invoked by the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?
